svg.title: METAR decoded field by field
svg.desc: An example METAR with made-up values, KGGG 161753Z AUTO 14021G26KT 3/4SM +TSRA BR BKN008 OVC012CB 18/17 A2970 RMK PRESFR, decoded in order: report type, station identifier, date and time in UTC, modifier, wind, visibility, weather, sky condition, temperature and dew point, altimeter setting, remarks, and the variable wind group.
svg.text: Example METAR (made-up values), read left to right
METAR KGGG 161753Z AUTO 14021G26KT 3/4SM +TSRA BR BKN008 OVC012CB 18/17 A2970 RMK PRESFR
METAR
Type of report. Routine METAR is sent at regular
times. SPECI is a special report, any time, for
rapidly changing weather or other critical
information.
KGGG
Station: four-letter ICAO code. In the 48 states, K
plus the three-letter identifier. Alaska starts with
PA, Hawaii with PH.
Date and time: 16th day, 1753 UTC. Z means Zulu
(UTC), not local time.
AUTO
Modifier: report came from an automated source. COR
means a corrected report that replaces an earlier
one.
Wind: from 140 degrees true, 21 knots, gusting to
26. VRB = variable. Over 99 knots uses three digits.
3/4SM
Prevailing visibility in statute miles. RVR, if
reported: R17L/1400FT = 1,400 ft on runway 17 left.
+TSRA BR
Weather: intensity first (light -, moderate, heavy
+; VC = 5 to 10 mi away). Here: heavy thunderstorm
with rain, and mist.
BKN008 OVC012CB
Sky: amount, height, type. Broken at 800 ft,
overcast at 1,200 ft with cumulonimbus. Heights are
hundreds of feet AGL. VV003 = indefinite ceiling.
Temperature 18 C, dew point 17 C. M before a value
means below zero.
Altimeter setting 29.70 inches of mercury. Always A
plus four digits.
RMK PRESFR
Remarks always begin with RMK. PRESFR = pressure
falling rapidly; PRESRR = pressure rising.
dddVddd
Variable wind: if direction varies more than 60
degrees and speed is over 6 knots, the extremes
follow, split by V.
Sky cover is reported in eighths of the sky. Automated stations do not detect or report clouds above 12,000 ft.
